CustomField.description: A dismissal: the two record identifiers it is about, in ascending order and joined with a hyphen. A match reason: the 18 character identifier of the duplicate record set it explains. Unique, so a pair is dismissed once however often the scan runs, and a suggestion has one reason.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The two records that are not duplicates of each other, or the suggestion a match reason explains.
CustomField.label: Pair Key
